Changes:
0: [home, wait_info] waiting_screen_progress_milestones_info: Adds explicit progress status indicators and milestone status details during the rendering waiting step. (why: The waiting step has a high mean duration of 2336s (median 201s). Lessons show wait_info changes consistently perform well.)
1: [finish, redesign] home_intro_desktop_visibility_redesign: Redesigns home_intro into a spotlight layout focusing on desktop pet visibility and initial activation steps. (why: 3 support emails reported pets not appearing on the desktop or failing to open upon completing onboarding.)
2: [adoption, new_screen] new_screen_adoption_preview_confirmation: Inserts a new confirmation screen prior to certificate issue to review custom pet features. (why: 3 support tickets noted issues with custom pet generation failing or rendering incorrectly during adoption.)
3: [choose_path, new_flow] choose_path_interactive_preview_flow: Rebuilds choose_path with interactive path cards allowing users to preview starter options before selecting. (why: Choose path shows a 21.2% dropoff rate and a high mean duration of 514s due to decision hesitation.)
4: [finish, hint] home_intro_control_dock_hint: Displays explicit instructions on how to summon, control, and interact with the pet post-setup. (why: 3 support emails reported post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the pet.)
5: [sign_in, notification] sign_in_account_sync_notification: Adds a notification informing users that signing in restores existing account pets and progress. (why: 8 support emails (the top issue group) cited missing or reset pets after signing in.)
6: [adoption, redesign] upload_photos_compact_grid_redesign: Redesigns upload_photos into a split layout to provide clear photo quality standards. (why: Adoption step has 77.2% conversion and users report custom pet creation failures in support mail.)
7: [home, layout] waiting_screen_two_column_layout: Reorganizes the waiting screen into a two-column view separating render status from desktop tips. (why: Home wait time is long (mean 2336s). Lessons show home and wait layout changes perform effectively.)
8: [finish, new_flow] home_intro_first_interaction_flow: Rebuilds home_intro as a checklist flow verifying desktop controls before completing onboarding. (why: Reduces finish dropoff (76.5% step conversion) and addresses support issues around desktop pet misbehavior.)
